agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: Israel gives in, he instructs his sons about the gift, and Papa Dorin adds a joke. It needs to be condensed to one or two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards lets the baker reason out that Benjamin's portion was five times larger. Choosing among five, two and ten is luck, so the blank tests an unseen detail rather than a meaning the baker can infer.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
